ui_text.percentage_info: When it says 70%, about 7 in 10 such patients really were congested.
ui_text.estimate_info: Estimated by a model that never saw this patient. Typical error about 5 mmHg; the range shown contains 80% of past errors.
ui_text.congestion_definition: Congested = catheter wedge pressure above 18 mmHg (Cardiological Society of India, 2018).
ui_text.perfusion_info: Taken from catheter measurements in the patient record, never from the model.

cutoffs.source: CSI position statement on management of heart failure in India, Indian Heart J 2018;70:S1-S72, Fig. 7 (p. S20)

meta.note: Every estimate, range and chance comes from models that never saw that patient.
